records.source_meaning: The port worker observes that the fleet has no freight.
records.context: Ordinary Nagasaki departure, the Kurushima encounter, and the named prize from the boarding duel.
records.localization_note: The operator selected Cargo Setup with empty holds. The direct reply explains why the editor does not open.

prior_story.clean_Japanese:
FIのあねさんよ！
今日こそは決着をつけさせてもらうぜ！
prior_story.english: Well, FI! Today we settle this for good!
prior_story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
prior_story.rationale: The taunt and declaration open the confrontation. Keep the original given-name token.

prior_story.clean_Japanese:
クルシマ！
愚かな所行はやめよ！
prior_story.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
prior_story.rationale: The blunt rebuke sounds right as Yukihisa interrupts his challenge.

prior_story.clean_Japanese:
てめえ、侍のくせに
異国人の肩ぁ持ちやがって！
武士の風上にもおけねえ野郎だ！
prior_story.english: A samurai siding with foreigners? You're a disgrace!
prior_story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
prior_story.rationale: Keep the contemptuous question and accusation in Kurushima's voice.

prior_story.clean_Japanese:
大陸の沿岸を荒らし、無抵抗の民から
略奪するは
誇り高き武士の為すことか！
prior_story.english: You raid the mainland coast and rob people who can't fight back. Is that the way of a proud samurai?
prior_story.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
prior_story.rationale: Yukihisa answers the insult by invoking a samurai's code of conduct. The whole question stays together after the two direct charges.

prior_story.clean_Japanese:
おーおー、お堅えことを
俺の一番嫌いな性格だぜ
prior_story.english: Oh, listen to you. So stiff and proper. Just the sort I can't stand.
prior_story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
prior_story.rationale: Keep the sneer, the mock appraisal and the personal dismissal. Each beat can sit on its own row without separating the last clause.

prior_story.clean_Japanese:
へっへっへ、FIよ！
俺の女になるなら、おとなしく降参
してもいいぞ！
おめえの命だけは助けてやろう！
prior_story.english: Heh heh, FI! Be mine, and you can surrender quietly. I'll spare you and no one else!
prior_story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
prior_story.rationale: Kurushima makes his silence-and-surrender offer directly to Maria. She can surrender on his terms and he promises to spare her alone. Keep the given-name token.

prior_story.clean_Japanese:
ソウジン・クルシマ…
それ以上無駄口を叩くようなら、その
威気高な髭をむしり取ってあげるわ
prior_story.english: Sojin Kurushima... Mouth off again and I'll pluck out that high-and-mighty beard!
prior_story.speaker: Maria Li
prior_story.rationale: The insulting threat ridicules his pretension and rejects his offer in Maria's voice.

prior_story.clean_Japanese:
がっはっはっは！
……ぶち殺ーす！！
prior_story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
prior_story.rationale: The bitter turn from laughter to an explicit threat closes the exchange.
